Leyla (CS): Quick FYI — NexusTel wants a short Ramadan promo: new ME region routing (me-central-1), partner IP allowlist, SSO (SAML) setup, and a temporary QPS bump for ~2 weeks. They also mentioned a future Private deployment + KMS/HSM ask.

Omar (NexusTel): Correct. 10-day dev->prod promo window, peak hours 09:00-21:00 GST. Can we boost to 1k QPS (baseline 250)? Partner endpoints below. Need SAML metadata exchange too.

Priya (NetOps): Please paste CIDRs and expected egress. We can open peering to me-central-1 but need to confirm PoP availability and TLS/client cert requirements.

Omar (NexusTel): CIDRs: 197.55.10.0/24, 197.55.11.45/32. Peak egress ~300Mbps. No client certs for now; token-based mTLS planned later.

Hannah (Solutions Eng): Plan: 1) create ephemeral allowlist with auto-revoke on 2025-05-05; 2) apply temporary qps profile "promo-1k" scoped to me-central-1 + specific routes; 3) schedule 30m SAML setup; 4) open Private deployment discovery ticket for Q3.

Noah (AE): Renewal flag — they want data residency confirmation and audit artifact. This could affect contract renewal. CS/solutions: capture a short attestation to attach to the renewal playbook. I'll escalate to Legal for wording.

Leyla (CS): I'll book the enablement/SAML call for tomorrow 10:30 GST and draft the runbook. Omar, which routes need the lift? Full generate surface or limited?

Omar (NexusTel): Mostly /v1/generate plus a small set of /v1/embeddings for personalization. Keep embeddings capped at 200 concurrent.

Priya (NetOps): Provisioning checklist: - Peering request for me-central-1 - Apply allowlist: 197.55.10.0/24, 197.55.11.45/32 (auto-revoke: 2025-05-05T00:00:00Z) - Policy: promo-1k QPS, 09:00-21:00 GST, route tag = nexus-promo - Monitoring: alert at 75% capacity -> escalate to @Leyla

provision-bot: Created ticket INF-4621. ETA for peering PoP reservation: 18h. Promo QPS profile applied to staging. Auto-revoke scheduled.

Hannah (Solutions Eng): I'll attach a short SAML test matrix (ACS URL, SP EntityID, attribute mappings email/name/org) to the ticket and include Console enablement steps.

Leyla (CS): Renewal artifact list: region-specific storage log bundle + KMS isolation note. Noah, can you draft the short doc?

Noah (AE): Taking ownership. Will coordinate with Security and attach updated doc by EOD tomorrow.

Omar (NexusTel): Thanks, please ensure allowlist is temporary and audited.

Priya (NetOps): Noted. Auto-revoke + audit trail enabled. Will post INF-4621 updates when PoP reserved.

Leyla (CS): Recap -> INF-4621: peering + ephemeral allowlist + promo-1k profile + SAML call 10:30 GST tomorrow. Renewal doc assigned to Noah. Ping here for changes.

provision-bot: INF-4621 update: PoP reserved (me-central-1, JLT). Staging config deployed.

Omar (NexusTel): Got it, see you on the call. :thumbsup:

(END)
